name: Nested Learning-Space Expansion Beyond Convex Sites
definition: On $\{a,b,c,d\}$ let $B$ contain the sets satisfying $c\in T\Rightarrow T\cap\{a,b\}\ne\varnothing$ and $d\in T\Rightarrow T\cap\{b,c\}\ne\varnothing$. Let $S=\{\varnothing,\{a\},\{a,b\},\{a,b,c\},\{a,b,c,d\}\}$.
properties: $S\subseteq B$ are learning spaces, so their peripheral expansion is a reflected learning space and maximum-generated. The site $S$ is not convex in $B$: it contains opposite vertices of a cube but omits other vertices. The complementary face criterion also fails, since the smallest face containing $B^c$ is $b=0$ and its trace in $S^c$ has six vertices rather than four.
